source.title: Mid-Ulster Mail, 21 May 1949, p. 5 ("Tyrone County Council")
source.publisher: Mid-Ulster Mail (via the British Newspaper Archive)

note: Triennial election of the 16 electoral divisions of Cookstown rural district, one member each, polled on 2 June 1949. There were no contests; S. Park withdrew in Stewartstown, and J. Doris was deemed re-elected in Mullanahoe, where no nomination was received. No nomination was received; the retiring member was deemed re-elected. Deemed re-elected (no nomination).
